title: Materialize FA3 Operating Levels, individual application entitlements and continuous Application Portfolio
decision: Operating Level and application entitlement are orthogonal.
Applications remain individually selectable through Enterprise unless explicitly non-entitleable.
Required technical dependencies are available to selected applications without granting unrelated user-facing applications.
Domain Packs are optional bundles and may not become technical dependencies.
Portfolio classification is retrospective, continuous and separate from provisioning lifecycle.
Product entitlement may restrict but never widen Security, License & Rights, Hardware, Model Router, HRB or Evidence decisions.
Capability baseline remains 175 and no new architectural authority is created.
